notes: MiniMax-M2.7 AutoRound INT4 on 4x Intel Arc Pro B70. Warm c2 JSON/content quality gate, one warmup wave excluded, repeat=2, 12/12 raw measured candidates passed strict JSON/content validation. tokSOut is wall accepted-output throughput across 2 concurrent requests; per-request accepted-output rate was 32.031 tok/s. Prompt padding was 6144 tokens, max_model_len=8192, max_num_batched_tokens=512. Control-character logit bias disabled because it trips XPU Indexing.h:622 at c2; validator still rejects control characters.
